recommendation: Keep this source fix as a narrow continuation of the original FHIR-16547 decision and the later FHIR-36674 registry-alignment pattern; no further core change is indicated for code or patient duplicates from the checked active source.
issue_request: FHIR-16547 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked why common search parameters code and patient appeared twice in the FHIR-core search parameter registry; the accepted resolution was to work through search parameter definitions and remove spurious differences.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit c7f72fcc93572b3d78aeea773248f02394791522 / svn revision 14050, which moved Medication code, identifier, and patient bases into common clinical entries and commented out separate medications-* common entries.
additional_context: Later FHIR-36674 registry alignment, already published on the combined branch as commit 2310ecd8cf8f53c5906d2c13180e606cd841a927, used the same base-list pattern for patient outliers and added DeviceAlert to clinical-patient. DeviceAlert-code was introduced later as an active resource-level code search parameter but had not been added to clinical-code.
reconciliation: Added <base value="DeviceAlert"/> to source/searchparameter/common-search-parameters.xml clinical-code, the common registry input used by the search parameter registry.
source_changes: source/searchparameter/common-search-parameters.xml: added DeviceAlert as a base of clinical-code so DeviceAlert-code is aggregated with the common code search parameter.

related_jiras.note: Later Published registry-alignment issue folded equivalent patient search parameters into clinical-patient and is already represented on the combined branch.
